sloka: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः ।त्रील्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य तमेव शरणं गतः ।। ५.३८.३३।।।।
transliteration: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiśca samaharṣibhiḥ ।trīllokān saṁparikramya tameva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ ।। 5.38.33।।।।

translations.english: 'Then the crow went round all the three worlds, having been rejected by his father Indra, including all the sages and gods. Refused by all he came back to Rama seeking shelter.
